samples.title: Điện thoại trong lớp
samples.prompt: The proposal is that teachers should allow phones for carefully planned classroom activities. Do the advantages of this proposal outweigh its disadvantages?
requirementsVi: Chọn bên có sức nặng hơn.
Thừa nhận và phân tích bất lợi.
So sánh mức độ tác động, không chỉ đếm số ý.
samples.summaryVi: Điện thoại có ích khi có nhiệm vụ rõ; thông báo và luật dùng không rõ dễ gây xao nhãng.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: The proposal that teachers should allow phones for carefully planned classroom activities has both positive and negative aspects. In my view, the advantages can outweigh the disadvantages if basic practical support is included. The main benefit addresses a recurring everyday need, while at least some of the difficulties can be reduced through careful organisation.
paragraphs.noteVi: Nêu đánh giá và điều kiện rõ ràng.

paragraphs.label: Thừa nhận bất lợi
paragraphs.text: A difficulty that should not be ignored is that notifications can distract students. This matters because a device used for learning also gives access to games and private messages. For instance, a pupil may stop following a discussion after receiving several messages from friends. The result may be frustration or a decision to stop taking part. This is not simply a question of people refusing to make an effort; practical conditions can prevent a reasonable idea from working as intended.
paragraphs.noteVi: Không bỏ qua phía yếu hơn.

paragraphs.label: Lợi ích lớn hơn
paragraphs.text: One important point in favour of the proposal is that students can quickly access useful learning material. This is possible because a shared task can direct phone use towards a specific question rather than casual browsing. For example, a class can compare two digital maps to explain how a neighbourhood has changed. The value of this example is that the benefit is connected with a real everyday need. It is easier for people to see the purpose of an approach when they can relate it to their own situation.
paragraphs.noteVi: Điện thoại có ích khi có nhiệm vụ rõ; thông báo và luật dùng không rõ dễ gây xao nhãng.

paragraphs.label: So sánh sức nặng
paragraphs.text: I give greater weight to the benefit because it could help people repeatedly, not just on one special occasion. The disadvantage is still important, but it is not always unavoidable. One response would be to agree on specific times for phone use and keep devices away during other tasks. A teacher could allow phones for a five-minute research task and then ask students to put them in their bags. This gives a concrete reason to believe that the obstacle can be reduced rather than merely ignored.
paragraphs.noteVi: So sánh tính lặp lại của lợi ích và khả năng giảm bất lợi.

paragraphs.label: Kết bài
paragraphs.text: In conclusion, I believe the advantages are greater when the approach is organised responsibly. If the practical support is absent, the balance could change. The strongest case is therefore for a workable version of the proposal, not for assuming that any version will automatically succeed.
paragraphs.noteVi: Chốt nhất quán, không khẳng định luôn đúng.

paragraphs.noteVi: Sửa giúp kéo dài tuổi thọ đồ điện tử; cần biết chi phí và tính khả thi trước khi quyết định.

paragraphs.label: So sánh sức nặng
paragraphs.text: I give greater weight to the benefit because it could help people repeatedly, not just on one special occasion. The disadvantage is still important, but it is not always unavoidable. One response would be to ask for a diagnosis and a cost estimate before deciding. A repair service could explain the likely benefit, price and warranty in simple language. This gives a concrete reason to believe that the obstacle can be reduced rather than merely ignored.
paragraphs.noteVi: So sánh tính lặp lại của lợi ích và khả năng giảm bất lợi.

paragraphs.label: Kết bài
paragraphs.text: In conclusion, I believe the advantages are greater when the approach is organised responsibly. If the practical support is absent, the balance could change. The strongest case is therefore for a workable version of the proposal, not for assuming that any version will automatically succeed.
paragraphs.noteVi: Chốt nhất quán, không khẳng định luôn đúng.
